message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Your quality commitment is the part of your offer we want to work on, and our options turn it into a trade that pays off for both sides: a firmer quality promise from Kalwisz, and no chargeback per complaint for you.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. It asks for a tighter quality commitment than your offer and takes the chargeback off the table, so your team can plan its work without that exposure. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Options B and C are there if you prefer to commit to an even tighter quality level.

Marek, what would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

Our main proposal is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

Hi, we can go with your Option A for 1500 ppm and 0 chargeback, no problem. I can drop the price to 46.50 EUR for this setup, which is a good discount from our first offer. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

This proposal is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
